claims: Aerojet Rocketdyne is an L3Harris company.
Lockheed Martin builds the Orion spacecraft.
Boeing produces the 212-foot core stage for the Artemis missions.
The 212-foot core stage houses the main engines and flight systems.
Northrop Grumman manufactures the twin five-segment solid rocket boosters for the Artemis missions.
The twin five-segment solid rocket boosters provide 75% of the thrust at launch.
Aerojet Rocketdyne supplies the RS-25 engines for the Artemis missions.
Aerojet Rocketdyne supplies other propulsion systems for the Artemis missions.
Airbus builds the European Service Module (ESM) for the Orion capsule for the European Space Agency.
United Launch Alliance (ULA) developed the Interim Cryogenic Propulsion Stage (ICPS).
The Artemis II crew's journey in space has begun.
NASA manages the Space Launch System (SLS).
Space Launch System (SLS) components are manufactured across the U.S. and in Europe.
